segments.text: Now that we cover why safety matters, let's dive into the hazards you might face in a
segments.zh: 既然我们已经讲了安全为什么重要，现在就来深入了解一下你在

segments.text: lab.
segments.zh: 实验室里可能面临的危害。

segments.text: Some are easy to spot, others not so much, but both can mess up your day if you're not
segments.zh: 有些很容易发现，有些就没那么容易了，但如果你不保持

segments.text: alert.
segments.zh: 警惕，两者都可能毁掉你的一天。

segments.text: Labs are full of chemicals, some toxic, some flammable, and others just unpredictable.
segments.zh: 实验室里到处都是化学品，有的有毒，有的易燃，还有的根本无法预料。

segments.text: Spills, leaks, or fires can happen in an instant if you're not paying attention.
segments.zh: 如果你不注意，洒漏、泄漏或火灾可能在一瞬间发生。

segments.text: Imagine you spill acetone, a highly flammable solvent.
segments.zh: 想象一下，你洒了丙酮，一种高度易燃的溶剂。

segments.text: Your first move?
segments.zh: 你的第一步是什么？

segments.text: Turn off or remove any source of ignition, ventilate, contain the spill, and keep anything
segments.zh: 关闭或移除任何点火源，通风，控制洒漏，并让任何

segments.text: flammable away.
segments.zh: 易燃物远离。

segments.text: Quick thinking can save a whole lot of trouble.
segments.zh: 快速反应可以省去很多麻烦。

segments.text: Biological risks like pathogens and allergens are the ones you don't always see coming.
segments.zh: 病原体和过敏原之类的生物风险，往往是你防不胜防的。

segments.text: Contamination can hit fast if you're not careful.
segments.zh: 如果你不小心，污染可能来得很快。

segments.text: You could be drawing blood and the needle slips.
segments.zh: 你可能正在抽血，针头一滑。

segments.text: Suddenly, you're exposed to a blood-borne pathogen, there's no time to hesitate.
segments.zh: 突然间，你就暴露于血源性病原体，没有时间犹豫了。

segments.text: Stop, contain, disinfect, and follow protocol to keep yourself and everyone safe.
segments.zh: 停下来，控制住，消毒，并按规程操作，保护自己和每个人的安全。

segments.text: Everyday risks like fires, electrical issues, or slipping on a wet floor are always lurking
segments.zh: 火灾、电气问题或在湿地板上滑倒之类的日常风险，总是潜伏

segments.text: in the background.
segments.zh: 在背后。

segments.text: It's easy to ignore them until something happens.
segments.zh: 在出事之前，人们很容易忽视它们。

segments.text: You're working with a Bunsen burner and the flame gets too close to some of the chemicals.
segments.zh: 你正在使用本生灯，火焰离一些化学品太近了。

segments.text: Now your workstation's on fire.
segments.zh: 现在你的工作台着火了。

segments.text: Don't panic.
segments.zh: 别慌。

segments.text: Evacuate, grab the extinguisher, and put it out before it spreads.
segments.zh: 疏散，拿起灭火器，在火势蔓延之前把它扑灭。

segments.text: Fast action is key.
segments.zh: 快速行动是关键。

segments.text: Radioactive materials come with serious risks.
segments.zh: 放射性材料伴随着严重的风险。

segments.text: Contamination and radiation exposure are no joke.
segments.zh: 污染和辐射暴露可不是开玩笑的。

segments.text: Handle them with extra care.
segments.zh: 处理它们时要格外小心。

segments.text: If something goes wrong with radioactive isotopes, isolate the area immediately, contain the
segments.zh: 如果放射性同位素出了问题，立即隔离该区域，控制住

segments.text: issue, and start decontamination to limit exposure and keep everyone safe.
segments.zh: 问题，并开始去污，以限制暴露，保证每个人的安全。

segments.text: Repetitive strain injuries are more common than you think.
segments.zh: 重复性劳损比你想象的更常见。

segments.text: Repeating the same motions for hours adds up, stressing your body.
segments.zh: 连续几个小时重复同样的动作会累积起来，给你的身体造成压力。

segments.text: If you're pipetting for hours and your setup isn't ergonomic, you'll feel it
segments.zh: 如果你连续几个小时移液，而你的工作台设置又不符合人体工学，你以后

segments.text: later in your back or wrists.
segments.zh: 就会在背部或手腕上感觉到。

segments.text: Adjusting your station now can save you from serious discomfort down the road.
segments.zh: 现在就调整好你的工作台，可以让你日后免受严重的不适。
